title: Understanding Confidence Intervals
text: Confidence intervals provide a range of values that likely contain the true parameter value. If a confidence interval for a parameter includes zero, it suggests that the parameter might not have a significant effect.

title: Interpreting $$\Theta_0$$
text: The confidence interval for \( $$\theta_0$$ \) is $$[44.808$$, $$45.013]$$. Since this interval does not include zero, \( $$\theta_0$$ \) is likely to have a significant effect.

title: Interpreting $$\Theta_1$$
text: The confidence interval for \( $$\theta_1$$ \) is $$[-0.026$$, $$0.342]$$. Since this interval includes zero, \( $$\theta_1$$ \) might not have a significant effect.

title: Interpreting $$\Theta_2$$
text: The confidence interval for \( $$\theta_2$$ \) is $$[-0.142$$, $$1.324]$$. Since this interval includes zero, \( $$\theta_2$$ \) might not have a significant effect.

title: Conclusion from Confidence Intervals
